description: This Java source file defines a REST controller for managing tenant profiles in the Thingsboard platform. It includes endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, and setting default tenant profiles, with detailed annotations for API documentation and security.

classes.name: TenantProfileController
classes.description: REST controller for tenant profile management, including CRUD operations and setting default profiles.

methods.name: getTenantProfileById
methods.description: Fetches a tenant profile by its ID.

methods.name: getTenantProfileInfoById
methods.description: Fetches tenant profile info by ID.

methods.name: getDefaultTenantProfileInfo
methods.description: Fetches the default tenant profile info.

methods.name: saveTenantProfile
methods.description: Creates or updates a tenant profile.

methods.name: deleteTenantProfile
methods.description: Deletes a tenant profile by ID.

methods.name: setDefaultTenantProfile
methods.description: Sets a tenant profile as default.

methods.name: getTenantProfiles
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of tenant profiles.

methods.name: getTenantProfileInfos
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of tenant profile info objects.

methods.name: getTenantProfilesByIds
methods.description: Retrieves tenant profiles by an array of UUIDs.

methods.name: getTenantProfileList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tenant profiles by UUIDs.
